title: Large phases at feature cap should include sub-phasing guidance for space_split
description: Phase 1 contains exactly 35 features (the upper bound). Of these, 14 are infrastructure/tech-stack standards. The remaining 21 decompose into a linear pipeline chain, admin CRUD, and employee management. A note suggesting how space_split should decompose this would help.
root_cause: The manifest generation step doesn't add meta-guidance when a phase is at or near the size cap. Space_split operators could benefit from suggested epic decomposition patterns.
recommendation: When a phase is at or near the feature cap (>30 features), add a 'Suggested Epic Decomposition' note to the Phase E2E Test section suggesting how the features naturally group for parallel work.
